title: One parcel fee, many item charges
hook: A fixed parcel fee is different from a fee attached to each item.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Separate per-parcel overhead from per-item charges when aggregating shipments.

misconception: Combining parcels removes every charge, including per-item charges.
objective: Separate per-parcel overhead from per-item charges when aggregating shipments.

claims.text: A fictional parcel costs €3 plus €0.50 per item. Items can share one parcel or each use a parcel. Scaled model; fictional policy; shared parcel permitted; no other fees.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Items=4, A=€14 and B=€5. The geometry pictures follow the declared dimension relationships; other stage pictures are scaled to the larger displayed comparison and icons are not literal item counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["*",3.5,"x"]; B=["+",3,["*",0.5,"x"]]; x denotes Items. At x=4, A=14, B=5; recall at x=7: B=6.5. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals.

claims.text: The per-item charge repeats either way, but the fixed parcel fee repeats only with separate parcels. Labeling a cost as fixed requires naming the thing it is fixed per.

claims.text: A fictional parcel costs €3 plus €0.50 per item. Items can share one parcel or each use a parcel. Change only Items to 7. What is B (Combined) now? Correct: €6.5. Use B's stated rule with Items=7: it gives €6.5. The per-item charge repeats either way, but the fixed parcel fee repeats only with separate parcels. Labeling a cost as fixed requires naming the thing it is fixed per.

recall.question: A fictional parcel costs €3 plus €0.50 per item. Items can share one parcel or each use a parcel. Change only Items to 7. What is B (Combined) now?
recall.why: Use B's stated rule with Items=7: it gives €6.5. The per-item charge repeats either way, but the fixed parcel fee repeats only with separate parcels. Labeling a cost as fixed requires naming the thing it is fixed per.
